title: Configuring the Google Threat Intelligence Connector

blocks.text: Google Threat Intelligence (powered by VirusTotal) aggregates threat and vulnerability intelligence to help organizations identify and respond to malicious activity across their environment. Google Threat Intelligence combines VirusTotal, Mandiant, and Google threat intelligence capabilities, and runs on the VirusTotal platform.

The Google Threat Intelligence connector retrieves CVE vulnerability records from VirusTotal, including the CVE identifier and the date each vulnerability was last modified. This allows you to correlate newly published or updated CVEs with other security data in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform).
The Google Threat Intelligence connector is in limited availability. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
For the Google Cloud Platform connector, see Configuring the Google Cloud Platform Connector. For the Google Sheets connector, see Configuring the Google Sheets Connector.
The Google Threat Intelligence source authentication configuration requires an API key. API keys for Google Threat Intelligence are generated and managed through the VirusTotal portal.
To generate a VirusTotal API key:

blocks.item: Click the Profile menu in the navigation bar, and select API Key.
From the API Key section, copy your API key.

blocks.text: Ensure the API key has the necessary permissions to access Vulnerabilities data on VirusTotal. The connector queries the Intelligence Search endpoint on full syncs, and the Collections endpoint on incremental syncs. If the key lacks read access to vulnerability data, these requests fail with a permissions or authorization error even though authentication itself succeeds.
To create the Google Threat Intelligence data source in the Agentic SecOps Platform:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Sources.
The Connect New Data Source page appears.
On the Connect New Data Source page, search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources

blocks.text: After you create the Google Threat Intelligence data source, enter the following information in the source setup Retrieval section:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
The Google Threat Intelligence Authentication window appears.
In the Google Threat Intelligence Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.
To learn more, see Configuring Authentication for Data Sources and Outegrations and Managing Authentication for Data Sources and Outegrations.

In the Start Date field, enter the earliest date you want to start ingesting data from, in the format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+00:00. If you don't provide a date, the connector ingests data from the last year by default. If you enter a date more than one year in the past, the connector automatically adjusts it to one year ago.

blocks.text: For deployment guidance and complete configuration instructions, see Deploying Data Source Configurations and Creating Data Sources.
